December 03rd, 2026
Location: GM University, Davangere

Event Participation & Benefits:

We are excited to welcome all participants to IGNITRON 2K26. Here are some important details regarding registration and accommodations:

  • Registration Fee: ₹500

  • Accommodation:
    For participants arriving from outside Davangere, accommodation will be arranged on a payable basis to ensure a comfortable stay. The accommodation details and payment link will be shared with the selected participants at the appropriate time. Teams are requested to fill out the accommodation form promptly once it is released.

  • Payment Link: Event Registration | GM University

Important Note:

  • You must first complete the registration process through the official Unstop platform.

  • Participants must follow the rules and regulations specified by the organizing team.

  • For any queries, feel free to reach out to our team. We look forward to seeing you at IGNITRON 2K26!

About CTF (Capture The Flag):

CTF (Capture The Flag) is an exciting and cybersecurity-focused event that provides participants with a platform to test their technical knowledge and problem-solving skills. It challenges participants to solve a series of security-related puzzles and challenges involving areas such as cryptography, web security, digital forensics, and logical reasoning to uncover hidden flags. Through critical thinking, analytical skills, and practical cybersecurity techniques, participants get an opportunity to demonstrate their knowledge and abilities. The event promotes cybersecurity awareness, teamwork, creativity, and the ability to identify and solve digital security challenges.
